name: Aberdeenshire
appliesTo: You are viewing school term dates without local holidays which differ between schools. Please select a school from the dropdown to view full list of dates.

localFacts.fact: Aberdeenshire lists term dates per school: occasional days (local holidays that differ between schools and areas) are added on top of the common calendar, and parents pick their school from a dropdown to see them.
Schools go back later than in most of Scotland: pupils start on Wednesday 19 August 2026 and Wednesday 25 August 2027, after two in-service days.
The October holiday lasts two weeks (12 to 23 October 2026).
The February break is one midterm holiday on a Monday followed by two in-service days, so pupils are off for three days.
The summer term runs into July: term 4 ends on Thursday 1 July 2027 and on Thursday 6 July 2028.
The council already publishes common dates for 2028-29 and 2029-30, without local holidays, which will be added closer to the start of each year.
Parents with a myAberdeenshire account can sign up for email alerts about school closures and transport changes, and the app sends push notifications about upcoming holidays.

2026-27.insetNote: Five in-service days in the common calendar: 17 and 18 August 2026, 13 November 2026, 9 and 10 February 2027.
2026-27.notes: Common dates without the occasional days (local holidays) that differ between schools and areas; check the school in the council's dropdown. Pupils start term 1 on Wednesday 19 August 2026. The spring holiday runs from Good Friday 26 March to 9 April 2027.

2027-28.insetNote: Five in-service days in the common calendar: 23 and 24 August 2027, 12 November 2027, 15 and 16 February 2028.
2027-28.notes: Common dates without the occasional days that differ between schools. Pupils start term 1 on Wednesday 25 August 2027. The spring holiday (3 to 13 April 2028) is followed by the Good Friday holiday on 14 April; term 4 starts on Monday 17 April 2028, Easter Monday. Summer holiday 7 July to 18 August 2028, as listed by the council.
